chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: What 52nd Street was like
summary: He describes 52nd Street as a pleasant, unbothered place, like the Village but better.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Just like the Village is now, only more so and more pleasant. There was no lot a bunch of nuts hungin around all the time. It was just pleasant down there. Pleasant place to go and hang out and not get bugged by nobody. Even the bars.
